items.title: How Eon built multi-cloud investigation with an MCP Gateway on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Learn how Eon replaced per-tool credentials and local MCP processes across AWS, GCP, and Azure with a single authenticated Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway, giving more than 100 developers and autonomous agents unified access to production investigation and cutting new-engineer onboarding from two days to two minutes.

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Denodo and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Build a governed semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with the Denodo Platform and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It federates Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, and an on-premises PostgreSQL database into a single customer 360 view an agent queries in VQL, with identity propagation and row- and column-level access control enforced at the semantic layer.
items.originalTitle: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Denodo and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Strategy Mosaic and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: The third post in our semantic-layer series builds a customer 360 across Amazon Redshift and Amazon Aurora with Strategy Mosaic, exposes it to a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore through the Mosaic MCP server, and enforces per-user row and column security end-to-end.
items.originalTitle: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Strategy Mosaic and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with AtScale and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: The third post in our semantic-layer series builds a governed customer 360 model on Amazon Redshift with AtScale, then exposes it to a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore through the AtScale MCP server. Identity propagation, RBAC, row security, and full query audit are enforced at the semantic layer, not the prompt.
items.originalTitle: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with AtScale and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

items.summary: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart onboarded over 100 new models from 30 providers in the first three quarters of 2026. This recap covers the model-onboarding highlights and JumpStart enhancements, including the simplified Model Hub, pre-configured deployment options, and Hugging Face deep link integration.
items.originalTitle: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: 2026 year-to-date in review

items.title: Pegasus 1.5 from TwelveLabs is now available in Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5 is now available in Amazon Bedrock. The video language model turns long-form video into structured, timestamped metadata: define the moments that matter and get every matching segment back as JSON, with new video segmentation, multimodal prompting with reference images, and on-the-fly processing of up to two hours of video.
items.originalTitle: Pegasus 1.5 from TwelveLabs is now available in Amazon Bedrock

items.title: How Deepgram optimized voice AI at scale with AWS Trainium
items.summary: Deepgram worked with the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering team to port its Nova-3 speech-to-text model to AWS Trainium2 for offline batch inference. This post covers porting to the AWS Neuron stack, kernel-level tuning, a data-parallel Rust runtime, and the throughput and cost results on batch transcription.
items.originalTitle: How Deepgram optimized voice AI at scale with AWS Trainium

items.title: Push-based KV transfer to improve TTFT and TPOT for disaggregated inference in vLLM
items.summary: vLLM's prefill-decode disaggregation splits LLM inference across engine instances but must transfer the KV cache between them. This post introduces a push-based NIXL connector that moves transfer coordination off the critical path, delivering up to 3x better TTFT and 30% better TPOT in benchmarks on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with AWS EFA.
items.originalTitle: Push-based KV transfer to improve TTFT and TPOT for disaggregated inference in vLLM

items.title: Improve TTFT for multi-turn agentic workloads with bi-directional KV transfer in vLLM
items.summary: Multi-turn agentic workloads reprocess growing conversation context each turn, driving up latency. See how bi-directional KV cache transfer lets prefill and decode nodes reuse previously computed context across turns, cutting time to first token by up to 1.6x for Qwen3-32B and 3.3x for GLM-5-FP8 on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with EFA.
items.originalTitle: Improve TTFT for multi-turn agentic workloads with bi-directional KV transfer in vLLM
